dish: Beef laab (Lao beef salad with toasted rice powder) and Luang Prabang-style khao soi in clear chicken broth
w: 'Ahan' means food in Lao: Jamie and Chuckie Brown-Soukaseume's Willy Street restaurant cooks from Jamie's Lao childhood with Wisconsin ingredients. James Beard semifinalist for Best Chef: Midwest (2025) after an Emerging Chef nod; reviewed by Isthmus and profiled by PBS Wisconsin.

dish: Award-winning fish fry — cod and perch beer-battered with New Glarus Spotted Cow (Wednesdays & Fridays)
w: Dinner in an 1856 Italianate sandstone farmhouse (the National Register-listed John Mann House) with a stone-barn Stable Grill. Its Spotted Cow-battered fry is a Madison Magazine pick and an Isthmus food editor's favourite.

dish: Wild-caught fish fry Wednesdays & Fridays — cod, bluegill, walleye — with Madison Sourdough rye
w: A north-east-side neighbourhood pub whose sustainable, wild-caught fish fry runs twice a week; in Madison Magazine's fish-fry list, Travel Wisconsin's eight Madison fish-fry picks and City Cast's guide.

dish: Inventive cocktails with long-winded names, wild garnishes and irreverent glassware
w: A Tenney-Lapham cocktail bar (opened October 2024) that went national fast: Bon Appétit and Punch best new bar, a Tales of the Cocktail top-10 for the US Central, and a 2026 James Beard semifinalist for Best New Bar.

dish: Steaks and an all-day American menu, with live music
w: Sun Prairie's big supper-house-style restaurant, a four-time Best of Madison gold winner in 2025 (best restaurant, bartender, outdoor dining, catering).
